docs.summary: Everything a build needs, as plain data.
docs.remarks: One place the stages read from, instead of each reaching into ambient state. What is left over is the genuinely editor owned pieces, which a desktop build still holds in instance fields because the script compiler and the settings exporter need the live project.

members.name: ProjectName
members.signature: public required string ProjectName { get; init; }

docs.summary: Name of the project to build.

members.name: ProjectRoot
members.signature: public required string ProjectRoot { get; init; }

docs.summary: Root directory of the project on disk.

members.name: AssetCachePath
members.signature: public required string AssetCachePath { get; init; }

docs.summary: Where imported assets already sit on disk, one file per GUID.

members.name: TempPath
members.signature: public required string TempPath { get; init; }

docs.summary: Scratch space the build may create and delete freely.

members.name: OutputDirectory
members.signature: public required string OutputDirectory { get; init; }

docs.summary: Directory where the finished build is written.

members.name: Scenes
members.signature: public required IReadOnlyList<Guid> Scenes { get; init; }

docs.summary: Scenes to ship, in order. The first is the one the player opens.

members.name: Configuration
members.signature: public required BuildConfiguration Configuration { get; init; }

members.name: Packaging
members.signature: public required AssetPackagingMode Packaging { get; init; }

docs.summary: How assets are packaged: Embedded, ProwlPak, or LooseFiles.

members.name: DependenciesOnly
members.signature: public required bool DependenciesOnly { get; init; }

docs.summary: When true, only assets that are dependencies of the shipped scenes are included.
Maximum size of each asset pack in megabytes. Defaults to 512.
Per-platform build profile with scripting define symbols and other platform-specific settings. Null for default behaviour.
The first scene in the Scenes list, or Guid.Empty if the list is empty.
